subject.title: Feishu plugin WebSocket doesn't receive im.message.receive_v1 events

question: Should maintainers allocate live Feishu credentials or ask the reporter for redacted SDK/gateway diagnostics before allowing an automated fix attempt?
rationale: The local source path is wired, but the reported failure depends on an external Feishu tenant and cannot be narrowed safely from source-only evidence.

options.title: Run live Feishu QA first
options.body: Use a maintainer Feishu app or reporter-provided redacted logs to identify whether the event stops at Feishu platform delivery, the SDK WebSocket, dispatcher invocation, or OpenClaw parsing before assigning a fix.

options.title: Ask reporter for diagnostics
options.body: Keep the issue open but request redacted logs or a recording from current main/latest release that includes SDK `[ws] receive message` traces and OpenClaw Feishu logs.

options.title: Treat as configuration support
options.body: Close only if maintainers determine from new evidence that the app's Feishu console subscription/scopes are misconfigured rather than an OpenClaw code path.

recommendation.title: Run live Feishu QA first
recommendation.body: Use a maintainer Feishu app or reporter-provided redacted logs to identify whether the event stops at Feishu platform delivery, the SDK WebSocket, dispatcher invocation, or OpenClaw parsing before assigning a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The plugin metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin community owner signal, and the missing proof is specific to a live Feishu plugin tenant.
